name: JUFA Wipptal
beschreibung: JUFA Hotel Wipptal is situated in Steinach am Brenner in the authentic Wipptal Valley, only a short stroll from the Bergeralm cable car valley station. This contemporary hotel offers a welcoming, informal ambiance that caters to families, athletes, and alpine tour groups. Bright, spacious rooms provide functional comfort. Amenities include an on-site indoor sports arena, interactive children's play areas, and a relaxing sauna suite. The dining room serves varied buffets featuring regional Tyrolean recipes. In winter, the Bergeralm arena offers snow-sure ski slopes and floodlit toboggan runs, while summer invites exploration across untouched side valleys.
kurzbeschreibung: Family and active hotel in Steinach am Brenner in the Wipptal Valley featuring indoor sports, sauna, and mountain access.
